mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, directly increasing present value of future cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.0% signals labor market tightness, accelerating wage growth and corporate profit expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, directly boosting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in 60% or more of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes, a month-over-month decline in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals cooling inflation, reducing Fed tightening risk and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL declines and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 indicates strengthening manufacturing output, directly increasing corporate capacity utilization and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO exceeds 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market tightening, accelerating wage pressures and corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in 60% or more of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) signals sustained economic expansion, directly increasing corporate earnings visibility and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where GDPC1 shows positive quarterly growth.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals economic weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.
